_note: The village loudspeaker. files are relative to assets/ and baked by scripts/make_rozhlas.py (song, muffled announcement, clear OPAKUJEM, announcement again); the game stays silent until they exist. One broadcast every period_s seconds at a clock-derived moment, the same on every client. Each speaker is at full level within reference_distance, 6 dB quieter per doubling beyond it, and silent past max_distance, and its low-pass falls from near_cutoff_hz to far_cutoff_hz over the same range (duller with distance); the nearest `voices` speakers sound at once.
